project.name: 中国风海报

project.designRead: poster / cultural-appreciation / bold ink-wash elegance / low density / avoid neon gradients, modern geometric abstraction, cute/kawaii

colorSystem.primaryColorRole: 朱红 #B83B3B for seals and accent elements
colorSystem.brandHuePolicy: single primary hue (vermilion) with ink dark palette

styleContinuityAnchors.shapeSystem: sharp edges, minimal radius, rectangular stamps
styleContinuityAnchors.typographySystem: Noto Serif SC for display, Noto Sans SC for body, vertical writing for hero, KaiTi for poetic sections
styleContinuityAnchors.componentLanguage: decorative borders, stamp elements, ink-wash effects
styleContinuityAnchors.surfaceAndDepth: flat/layered paper, no shadows on static elements
styleContinuityAnchors.imageryAndIconography: traditional Chinese landscapes, ink-wash, nature motifs

sharedProjectShellContract.primaryColorSystem: single primary vermilion #B83B3B with ink palette
sharedProjectShellContract.typographySystem: Noto Serif SC display, Noto Sans SC body, vertical writing for hero title, KaiTi for accent text
sharedProjectShellContract.ctaStyle: poster format, no traditional CTA buttons

designSource.designDecisionSummary: 中国东方意境: 朱红印章色、墨色层次、宣纸质感、宋体楷体、竖排文字、水墨留白

pages.title: 中国风海报
